## Viewers

The L&U Viewer and Member Viewer panels display lost and unaccounted for data and member data for a given location, over a selected datetime range.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="L&amp;U Viewer">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />L&amp;U Viewer</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="L&amp;U Viewer">

- **Variable Selector** - Volume, Energy, and Mass; Calculated Factors; Flowing Parameters; Component Volume/Component Volume %; Component Mass/Component Mass %; Component Net Allowable
- **Data Viewer** - A graphical display represents changes in values as follows:

  - **Show/Hide Daily Data** - Display or hide daily L&U data cards
  - **Single/Multiple Row Display buttons** - Toggle between horizontal and vertical display of the cards.

##### Graphing Functionality

Use the Graphing functionality to generate current L&U data in a graph.

- **Chart Options**
  - Show data point makers

  - Show data point labels

  - Variables - Change or deselect the displayed variables in the graph

    Only variables selected in the L&U Variable Selectors will be shown in the drop-down.
- **Show Monthly/Daily Data** - Toggle between monthly and daily data in the graph.
- **Export to PNG** - Generate a PNG image of the current graph.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Member Viewer">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Member Viewer</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Member Viewer">

Two tabs are available in the Member Viewer panel:

- **Variable Selector**
  - **Show data for Recovery Analysis** - Add Recovery Eff %, Inlet GPM, and Outlet GPM rows to the data grid.
  - **Show Activity Codes** - Add activity codes column to the data grid
  - **Variable Selector** - Volume, Energy, and Mass; Calculated Factors; Flowing Parameters; Component Volume/Component Volume %; Component Mass/Component Mass %; Component Net Allowable

- **Data Viewer** - Member number, name and direction are displayed in the grid, followed by monthly totals.

  To display daily data, click on the arrow next to Monthly Total or Partial Total. To display hourly data, click on the plus sign (+) next to the date. A Member Hourly Viewer screen will display the hourly data.

  - **Member drop-down** - Switch between members of the selected location.

  - **Export Data to Excel and Graph Hourly Data** - Export appropriate file types of the current data.

    Multiple Member Hourly Viewer screens can be open at the same time.

  - **Export Data to Excel** - Generate an Excel spreadsheet containing the current data grid.

##### Graphing Functionality

Use the graphing functionality to generate current member meter and location data in a graph.

- **Chart Options**
  - **Chart Settings**
    - Single variable with multiple members
    - Multiple variables with single member
  - Show data point makers
  - Show data point labels
  - **Show logarithmic scale** - Transform the Y axis based on logarithmic scale. Only available when single variable with multiple members is selected.
  - **Primary Axis Variable** - Change or deselect the displayed primary variables in the graph. Only variables selected in the Member Viewer Variable Selectors will be shown in the drop-down.
  - **Secondary Axis Variables** - Display a secondary variable. Only available when single variable with multiple members is selected.
  - **Members** - Select locations
- **Show Monthly/Daily Data** - Toggle between monthly and daily data in the graph.
- **Export to PNG** - Generate a PNG image of the current graph.
